After completing the Key Cavern, you can meet Marin on the Toronbo Shores, south of Mabe Village. Link and Marin have a nice moment together, and then Marin becomes a temporary companion! Escort Marin to the Animal Village, where she can wake up the Sleeping Walrus. With the Walrus out of the way, Link can continue into the Yarna Desert and fight [Lanmola](#loc=56407). Defeat the boss to receive the Angler Key. The lock is south of the dungeon entrance, on the raised platform. **Level:** 7

**Required:** Bird Key

After completing the Key Cavern, you'll get access to the [Dream Shrine](#loc=56269) and the Ocarina. Afterwards, head south of the Ukuku Prairie to the Pothole Fields and Signpost Maze. Follow the directions of the signs until you find Mamu. Mamu will teach you the Frog's Song of Soul in exchange for 300 rupees. With a new song for your Ocarina, head back to Mabe Village. You may have noticed a bird-shaped weather vein in town, where Marin typically hangs out and sings. Push the bird statue to reveal stairs, which lead you to some rooster bones. Play the Frog's Song of Soul to revive the rooster. Carrying the rooster makes Link fly!

With your zombie rooster in tow, make your way to the [Hen House](#loc=53827) in the Tal Tal Mountain Range. Before reaching the [Hen House](#loc=53827), stop by a cave directly south of the [Hen House](#loc=53827) and use the rooster to fly over the chasm to finally pick up the Bird Key. The dungeon's lock is to the left of the cave entrance, behind some boulders.

This is easily the most confusing dungeon in the game. The main objective is to throw the iron ball at all four cracked pillars. This is easier said than done. It is _highly_ recommended to follow a video walkthrough to prevent getting lost and endlessly backtracking through the dungeon.

53772:
**Level:** 1

**Required:** Tail Key

To unlock this dungeon, you must retrieve the Tail Key from the Mysterious Forest. However, when you enter the forest, a raccoon will meddle with the map, ensuring you get lost and never find the key.

While you stumble around the Mysterious Forest, you will eventually find a hollow trunk that leads into a cave. Exit out the other side of the cave and pick up the Sleepy Toadstool on the ground. Find the [Witch's Hut](#loc=53809) and trade the Sleepy Toadstool for Magic Powder. Return to the Mysterious Forest and throw the Magic Powder at the raccoon. Now, you can navigate the north side of the Mysterious Forest and find the Tail Key in a chest.

The bridge to Kanalet Castle is being guard by Kiki. If you give [Bananas](#loc=53834) to Kiki, he'll let you pass.
53774:
**Level:** 6

**Required:** Face Key, Bow & Arrow

You probably already have the bow at this point in the game, but if not, head to the [Mabe Village Shop](#loc=53799) and purchase a bow for 980 rupees.

Next, you need to find the Face Key to unlock the gate to the dungeon. North of the Face Shrine, you can find the Ancient Ruins. The Ancient Ruins are filled with Armos, stone enemies that come alive when Link touches them. The easiest method to defeat an Armos is drop a bomb, and just as the bomb starts flashing red, touch the Armos, and run away. If you time it correctly, the bomb will explode and kill the Armos just as it wakes up. You only need to defeat the Armos that block your path to the Ancient Ruins temple. 

Inside the temple, you will find a mini-boss: the Armos Knight. The Armos Knight will chase you around the room, jumping and slamming the ground to try and stun Link. Use the Roc's Feather to jump just as the Armos Knight starts to fall to avoid the stun attack. As you attack the Armos Knight, his weapons and armor will fall off and he'll become easier and easier to attack. When the Armos Knight is finally defeated, pick up the Face Key.

Talk to the Fisherman by the pond to try your hand at the fishing game. 

The minigame's three "special" catches become available after completing [Catfish's Maw](#loc=53775) (Cheep Cheep and Blooper) & the [Face Shrine](#loc=53774) (Ol' Baron).

**Lightweight Lure** is best used when trying to catch Little Fish & small Cheep Cheep at the surface of the pond.

The **Middleweight Lure** is received as a reward for catching a Big Fish for the first time. It descends faster to the middle than the Lightweight or heavyweight Lures. This is the best lure to use when trying to catch Big Fish & Bloopers in the middle of the pond.

The **Heavyweight Lure** is received as a reward for catching a Blooper for the first time. It descends faster to the bottom than the Lightweight or Middleweight Lures. This is the best lure to use when trying to catch Big Fish & Ol' Baron at the bottom of the pond.
